summary: Review A of Phase S4 at a02740f finds one Major A4 defect in the A11 recipe and one Major no-guess gap in the doc drift detector. Plan truthfulness and the S3 checkpoint pass. Route to Green with retry_implementation.
blocking_findings: measure/anti-patterns.md:215: F1 [Major] review-a: The A11 recipe exits 0 with no output when a listed document is missing. A probe with measure/no-such-doc.md printed a grep error and exit=0, so the check passes on a missing deliverable (A4). The same recipe is in skills/measure-orchestrator/references/anti-pattern-catalog.md. Fix: fail when a listed document is absent, and add a missing-document fixture to the test.

tests/spec_review_gate/test_s4_doc_drift.sh:191: F1 [Major] review-a: The recipe check runs the recipe only in the real repository. It builds no missing-document fixture, so it cannot detect the A4 defect in F1. Add a fixture with a missing product.md or tech-stack.md and require a non-zero result.

agents/measure-orchestrator-audit.md:174: F2 [Major] review-a: The detector does not name the file that stores track status, completed, and updated_at. The track spec.md may not hold these fields; metadata.json is the likely source. Name the file, and state the audit date source for the 30-day window.

agents/measure-orchestrator-audit.md:172: F2 [Major] review-a: Scope lists spec.md files, but step 1 runs the A11 recipe on measure/product.md and measure/tech-stack.md only. Step 3 gives no check method for counts and behavior claims. Name the check method for each claim kind, or narrow the scope to match the recipe.
nonblocking_findings: tests/spec_review_gate/test_s4_doc_drift.sh:99: F3 [Nit] review-a: The detector checks use generic substrings such as scheduled, completed, cancelled, and updated_at. Each substring can pass in any part of the section. Check the exact sentence for each rule (A7-style weakness, carried from b5c7fb0).
agents/measure-orchestrator-audit.md:187: F4 [Nit] review-a: The detector output prefix is DRIFT:, but the A11 recipe prints DRIFT candidate:. Use one prefix for both, or state the difference.
